description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Wriggling Grub from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wriggling Grub, adding {B}.
When Wriggling Grub dies, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Worm creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Worm, adding {1}.
Repeat.
